passage: Okay, so you asked how I handled Payal's startup phase. I'm Indu, her roommate since first year, and for two months our room was one long pitch. Payal wanted to sell homemade pickles through a subscription app. Every time I raised a worry, like delivery costs, shelf life, or who pays monthly for pickles, she had an answer ready, and then she'd read me another comment from her post: "Genius!" She went quiet. Next day she asked me to list the no's with her.

Gopika has quit her part-time job to start a home tiffin service from our flat. I'm her flatmate, so I've watched it all. When her aunt praised her biryani, Gopika quoted it for a week. When the man at the next building said three tiffin services had already closed on our street, she said he was jealous. When I asked about the kitchen space, she said, "Varun, don't be negative."

Varun
